


IPv6 access list NETOPS-G82-V6
    permit tcp 2001:DB8:69::/64 host 2001:DB8:69::7 eq 22 sequence 10
    permit udp any any eq domain sequence 20
    permit icmp any any sequence 30
    deny ipv6 host 2001:DB8:69::9 any sequence 40
    permit ipv6 2001:DB8:1::/48 any sequence 50
    permit tcp any any eq www sequence 60
    permit ipv6 any any sequence 80
    permit tcp host 2001:DB8:69::1 any sequence 90
    permit ipv6 any 2001:DB8:69::/64 sequence 100
    permit icmp any any echo-reply sequence 110
